Returns ranked matches: id, title, source, licence, status, score. Use when an agent

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Return full detail for one dataset id, including its latest health status and last-verified timestamp, content_freshness_date, and freshness_signal_source (last_modified, content_parse, or none). Use to fetch the provenance/citation metadata for a dataset found via search_datasets and distinguish un

tools.name: find_stale
tools.description: Return datasets whose status is aging, stale, or degraded, plus datasets missing from the latest health snapshot. Use when an agent needs to know which data has a freshness or schema-validity risk.

tools.name: find_anomalies
tools.description: Return datasets flagged by the latest published anomaly detection (anomalies), ranked by how far the observed update interval exceeds its threshold. Optionally require a minimum publish-reliability grade; includes pipeline-computed anomaly and reliability evidence so agents do not recompute it.

tools.name: find_deteriorating
tools.description: Return datasets whose published freshness trend is deteriorating, ranked by staleness slope. Optionally require a minimum historical anomaly rate; includes pipeline-computed trend and reliability evidence so agents do not recompute it.

tools.name: find_recovering
tools.description: Return datasets whose published freshness trend is recovering, with the fastest staleness reductions first. Includes pipeline-computed trend and publish-reliability evidence.

tools.name: find_unreliable
tools.description: Return datasets whose evaluated publish-reliability grade is at or below a threshold (the unreliable ones), with the worst grades and lowest on-time percentages first. Reliability measures timeliness of successful freshness observations, not uptime; sample days are included so agents can judge evide

tools.name: find_schema_drift
tools.description: Return datasets with published structural or record-count drift evidence, ranked with structural changes first. Optionally require a minimum number of structural transitions; includes pipeline-computed evidence so agents do not infer drift from freshness alone.

tools.name: check_reconciliation
tools.description: Return the published cross-source reconciliation group for a dataset name or id, including per-member counts, dates, statuses, tolerances, and contextual deltas. A discrepancy requires human review and does not prove either source is wrong.

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: Return citation-ready provenance metadata for the listed dataset ids, plus compact pipeline-published evidence receipts: row probe time, HTTP status, request URL, access dependency, freshness source, content date, record count, shape fingerprint, anomaly flag, and status. Use when an agent must cite

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Return the complete pipeline-published evidence receipt for one dataset id, including probe time, transport, access dependency, freshness, record-count, shape, tolerance, status, and anomaly fields. tools.name: verify_evidence
tools.description: Perform a rate-limited live streamed GET for one direct-access dataset and compare transport receipts with the latest published evidence, e.g. verify_evidence('fuelprice'). tools.name: find_by_licence
tools.description: Return all datasets with the given licence, summarised. Use to enumerate what's available under a specific licence for compliance/reuse scoping.

tools.name: usage_summary
tools.description: Aggregate one buyer's audit-ledger usage for an inclusive ISO date range, e.g. 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-07. Returns `total_calls`, `by_tool`, `by_dataset`, `trust_distribution` (per-status counts of cited datasets) for the inclusive range.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_reconciliation, get_provenance · Private data: find_schema_drift, get_provenance, get_evidence · Public sink: find_anomalies, find_recovering, find_unreliable.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_reconciliation, get_provenance · Private data: find_schema_drift, get_provenance, get_evidence · Public sink: find_anomalies, find_recovering, find_unreliable

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_datasets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
